title: PLAIN AS DAY

events.name: SOHO
events.host: Henry Whitehead, curate of St Luke's
events.description: Cholera kills six hundred people in a few streets of Soho in under a month. Nobody agrees on what is doing it, and the men who could stop it are certain it is the air.
events.impact: The house-by-house map drawn during this outbreak is where the whole of modern epidemiology starts. Every outbreak investigation since has been a version of it.
skills: Reading a set of numbers without being fooled by it
Telling a fact from the story somebody wrapped it in
Backing up anything you claim, and saying where it came from
Spotting an objection that is actually right

_note_fragments: Fragments: one line, no name, no year, nothing playable.
fragments: ...someone counting out loud in a language I do not have.
...a bell, and then nothing for a long time.
...the weight of a coat that is not mine.
...a room where everyone is standing up.
...ink. My hands are covered in ink.
...they are burning something in the square.
...a name I am not allowed to say here.
...heat, and the sound of a great many engines.
...she is telling me I am wrong, and she is right.
